question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Piquant
solution:
The correct answer is: **Bland**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Piquant"** means something that is pleasantly stimulating or exciting to the mind or taste. It often refers to food that is spicy or tangy. (रोचक, तीखा)

 
 
• **Example:** The chef added a piquant sauce to the dish to enhance its flavor.
 
 
 
• **"Bland"** refers to something that is lacking strong flavor or excitement; it is mild or dull. (फीका, सुस्त)
 
 
• **Example:** The soup was bland and lacked any interesting flavors.
 
 
 
• Hence, the opposite of **"piquant"** is **"bland"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Bland**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Bitter** (कड़वा): Having a sharp, pungent taste or smell; not sweet.

 
 
• **Example:** The coffee tasted bitter because it was overbrewed.
 
 
 
• **Delicious** (स्वादिष्ट): Highly pleasing to the taste or senses.
 
 
• **Example:** The cake was so delicious that everyone went for seconds.
 
 
 
• **Delectable** (लजीज): Extremely pleasing or appetizing, especially in taste.
 
 
• **Example:** The banquet offered a variety of delectable dishes.
